product_updates.title: AfterQuery reportedly becomes Y Combinator’s fastest-ever unicorn, now valued at $3.2B
product_updates.content: AI model-training startup AfterQuery has reportedly raised a round that valued it at $3.2 billion, just five months after announcing its $30 million Series A at a $300 million valuation in April.

product_updates.title: OpenAI’s Astra model is on the way — and very good at breaking into computer systems
product_updates.content: OpenAI previewed the precautions it is taking as it prepares to release Astra, its newest, cyber-critical LLM.

product_updates.title: Google’s Android update tackles motion sickness, accessibility, and more
product_updates.content: While some of the features see Google playing catch-up to Apple, which already offers similar features for iPhone users, others specifically leverage Gemini to provide various improvements.

product_updates.title: Anthropic’s new Fable release is cheaper, less restrictive
product_updates.content: Fable 5.1 includes changes meant to reduce token cost and false-positive restrictions from the model's safeguards.

product_updates.title: Google’s answer to Canva is an AI tool where you prompt instead of design
product_updates.content: With Google Pics, Google is pushing deeper into the creative software market dominated by Canva and Adobe, but with a distinctly AI-first approach.

product_updates.title: ChatGPT Health adds Epic integration for clinicians to import patient data
product_updates.content: OpenAI said that the integration provides read-only access to health records for clinicians.

product_updates.title: Sequoia-incubated Empirik launches with $21M to predict outages before they happen
product_updates.content: The startup wants to do for IT infrastructure what Cursor did for software engineering.

product_updates.title: Amazon Alexa can now alert you when something new might tempt you to shop
product_updates.content: Amazon is adding a new Alexa-powered feature called “Update Me When” that can send personalized alerts about product launches, tours, books, shows, and other events that could trigger a purchase.

product_updates.title: AIR raises $50M to help companies vet the skills and add-ons AI agents use
product_updates.content: AIR's platform can discover agents running at a company, continuously vets any skills and add-ons they use, and blocks any unwanted behavior.

product_updates.title: Fambot introduces an ‘AI chief of staff’ for families
product_updates.content: Fambot is building an AI “chief of staff” to help families manage the emails, calendars, school updates, sports schedules, and other logistics of raising kids.
